sources.title: Adobe: U.S. Holiday Shopping Season to Hit Record $275.1 Billion Online, Rising 6.7% YoY
sources.notes: Read 2026-11-21 (curl GET, HTTP 200; dated Monday, September 28, 2026). Adobe Analytics forecast for 2026-11-01 to 2026-12-31: US online spending of $275.1 billion (up 6.7 percent); Cyber Week, which Adobe defines as the five days from Thanksgiving to Cyber Monday, $47.5 billion (up 7.4 percent); AI traffic to US retail sites, measured by shoppers clicking a link, expected to rise 130 percent year over year, with Thanksgiving up 159 percent, Black Friday up 95 percent and Cyber Monday up 88 percent. Digital Commerce 360 reported the forecast on 2026-09-29. A forecast, not an observation.

sources.title: Salesforce Data: Record Cyber Week Expected to Deliver $75.8B in AI-Driven Sales
sources.notes: Read 2026-11-21 (curl GET, HTTP 200; datePublished 2026-11-19T13:00:00Z). Forecast from Salesforce's Shopping Index (aggregated Agentforce, Commerce Cloud, Service Cloud and Marketing Cloud data on more than 1.5 billion shoppers, extrapolated with market assumptions). Cyber Week 2026, Tuesday 2026-11-24 to Monday 2026-11-30: global online sales of $357 billion (up 6 percent) and US online sales of $84 billion (up 6 percent); $75.8 billion, or 21 percent of global Cyber Week sales, influenced by AI and agents, up from $67 billion in 2025 (13 percent higher); AI-driven traffic to retailer sites up 104 percent year over year; 20 percent of holiday shopping traffic nonhuman. Salesforce's consumer survey: 31 percent have tried a personal agent (Salesforce names Meta's Muse and OpenAI's dots), 8 percent have had their agent make purchases for them, and 73 percent are not ready to hand a personal agent their credit card details. A separate claim, that shoppers who engage with a brand's shopper agent spend 8 percent more per order, is not the survey's 8 percent. Influence attribution, not purchases completed by agents.

metrics.metric: 8004scan registered agents
metrics.definition: total_agents in 8004scan's statistics API (mainnet view), read 2026-11-21T07:04:55Z UTC. It was 561,614 on 2026-10-11, 699,098 on 2026-10-18 and 2,062,896 on 2026-11-14.
metrics.caveat: Registrations, not working agents: a partial census (2026-09-26) found that only a small minority expose a working endpoint. Almost all of the growth since 2026-10-18 came from Central City batch registrations: two large waves on Base (2026-10-20 to 2026-10-23) and on Arc Mainnet (2026-11-01 to 2026-11-06), then a third, smaller one on Optimism (2026-11-14 and 2026-11-15, UTC). Sampled ids in these waves point to centralcity.ai, and Central City claims about 1.55 million agents (vendor claim, 2026-11-21). 8004scan does not index 0G, a mainnet in the contracts README, whose registry held about 3.94 million more ids on 2026-11-21 (mostly from one platform by sample), so on-chain registrations across chains exceed 6 million by highest id.

metrics.metric: 8004scan feedback submitted
metrics.definition: total_feedbacks in 8004scan's statistics API (mainnet view), read 2026-11-21T07:04:55Z UTC; it was 682,172 on 2026-10-11, 720,771 on 2026-10-18 and 885,869 on 2026-11-14.
metrics.caveat: Includes Sybil feedback; counts are not reputation quality. Feedback grew far more slowly than registrations: 1.4% against 3.6% for agents in the week to 2026-11-21.

metrics.metric: 8004scan unique wallets
metrics.definition: total_users in 8004scan's statistics API, shown as Unique Wallets on its home page, read 2026-11-21T07:04:55Z UTC; it was 496,840 on 2026-10-11, 755,027 on 2026-10-18 and 3,341,787 on 2026-11-14.
metrics.caveat: Wallets are not people or operators. On 2026-11-21 the count was about 1.6 times the agent count, and sampled Central City registrations each come from a different owner address.

metrics.metric: 8004scan networks indexed
metrics.definition: Networks shown on the 8004scan home page, read 2026-11-21 (29 on 2026-10-18 and 2026-11-14; 30 on 2026-10-11).
metrics.caveat: Not the same list as the 25 mainnets in the official contracts README: on 2026-11-21 the statistics API listed 30 mainnet chains (29 with a registry), including some the README omits such as Arc, and still left out 0G, a README mainnet. It indexes neither Flow EVM nor Neo X, where the same 2.0.0 registries answer.

metrics.metric: mppscan transactions (default window, apparently 7 days)
metrics.definition: Transactions in the 7-day window of MPPscan's protocol statistics, the home page default, read 2026-11-14 (62,011); 127.4 thousand were shown on 2026-10-11.
metrics.caveat: Third-party explorer; method not published. MPPscan's indexer appears to have stopped about 2026-11-11T17:15Z (newest indexed transaction among its top servers, while Tempo kept producing blocks), so this window holds only about 3.6 indexed days: do not read the lower figure as a fall in activity. Per indexed day this window's count matches the 2026-10-21 reading (about 17,200 a day in both) while value per day more than doubled; the 30-day window, normalized the same way, shows about a quarter fewer transactions a day than on 2026-10-21.

metrics.metric: mppscan volume (default window, apparently 7 days)
metrics.definition: Payment value in the 7-day window of MPPscan's protocol statistics, read 2026-11-14 (1,797.04 USD); 1.49 thousand USD were shown on 2026-10-11.
metrics.caveat: Third-party explorer; covers MPP payments it can see on chain, not Stripe card charges through Shared Payment Tokens. Indexed data ends about 2026-11-11, so the window holds about 3.6 indexed days.

metrics.metric: mppscan agents (default window, apparently 7 days)
metrics.definition: Distinct senders, which the home page labels Agents, in the 7-day window of MPPscan's protocol statistics, read 2026-11-14 (3,259); 3.7 thousand were shown on 2026-10-11.
metrics.caveat: Agents are payer addresses as the explorer defines them. Indexed data ends about 2026-11-11, so the window holds about 3.6 indexed days.

metrics.metric: mppscan servers (default window, apparently 7 days)
metrics.definition: Distinct recipients, which the home page labels Servers, in the 7-day window of MPPscan's protocol statistics, read 2026-11-14; 167 were shown on 2026-10-11.
metrics.caveat: Indexed data ends about 2026-11-11, so the window holds about 3.6 indexed days.

metrics.metric: Visa and Artemis: MPP volume
metrics.definition: Cumulative MPP payment value measured by Visa and Artemis, data to 2026-04-21, across about 115,000 transfers.

metrics.metric: Adobe forecast: growth in AI traffic to US retail sites, holiday 2026
metrics.definition: Visits to US retail sites from shoppers clicking a link in an AI service, 2026-11-01 to 2026-12-31, compared with the same period of 2025 (Adobe Analytics forecast).
metrics.caveat: Forecast of traffic, not purchases or agent-executed payments. It grows from the 2025 season, which Adobe measured at 693.4 percent above 2024, so the two rates do not share a base; compare it only with Adobe's own actuals for 2026.

metrics.metric: Salesforce forecast: Cyber Week 2026 online sales influenced by AI and agents
metrics.definition: Global online sales from 2026-11-24 to 2026-11-30 that Salesforce expects AI and agents to influence: 21 percent of a forecast $357 billion (Salesforce Shopping Index).
metrics.caveat: A vendor's forecast of influence attribution, not purchases completed by agents; global, not US-only, and seven days, not Adobe's five-day Cyber Week. Replace with Salesforce's actuals after Cyber Week, and never put it on an axis with observed volumes.

events.title: Mastercard CEO describes early consumer use of agentic payments, with no volume given
events.detail: On the Q3 2026 earnings call (third-party transcript) Michael Miebach said consumers are in the early stages of adopting agentic commerce but the numbers are not yet significant, that Shopify's Shop Pay is using Agent Pay and Mastercard network tokens, and that a broad partnership signed with OpenAI that quarter includes the use of Agent Pay. Mastercard's written results give no agent figures. Shopify itself says only that Shop Pay agent purchases from merchants off Shopify use Mastercard, Visa and Discover tokens (2026-10-28), without naming Agent Pay.

events.title: Observed: x402.org counter gone, 8004scan passes 2 million registrations, MPPscan indexer appears stalled
events.detail: x402.org no longer shows its Last 30 Days counter, which a capture of 2026-10-24 still had. 8004scan's statistics API counts 2,062,896 agents, about three times the 699,098 of 2026-10-18, mostly from two batch waves on Base and Arc Mainnet whose sampled registrations all point to Central City; it does not index 0G, whose registry had issued ids up to 3,941,206, so on-chain registrations across chains exceed 6 million by highest id. MPPscan's newest indexed transaction dates from 2026-11-11T17:14:56Z while Tempo kept producing blocks, so its indexer appears to have stopped and its rolling windows cover fewer days than their labels say.

events.title: Salesforce forecasts $75.8 billion of Cyber Week 2026 sales influenced by AI and agents
events.detail: A global forecast for 2026-11-24 to 2026-11-30: 21 percent of $357 billion, up from $67 billion in 2025. In Salesforce's consumer survey 8 percent say their agent has made purchases for them and 73 percent are not ready to give an agent their card details. Influence attribution, not checkouts completed by agents.
